name: Chronometron
effect: Necrons within 6m of a Chronometron gain AV *3 with the Force Shield trait, and gain +1 to Defense. Additionally, once per combat, the bearer of a Chronometron may Seize the Initiative without spending glory.
note: "AV *3" as printed (read as an Invulnerable Armour Rating 3). "Force Shield" is not a Core armour Trait and this book does not define it (1st-edition name); copied as printed. Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.

name: Canoptek Cloak
effect: A specialized platform designed to carry aloft a Cryptek, a Necron with a Canoptek Cloak increases its Speed characteristic to 10, and may fly like a vehicle with the Hover trait. In addition, once per round as a free action, the user may select a vehicle within 6m with the Living Metal trait and make a DN 4 Tech test. It heals d6 wounds instead of d3 wounds that turn if successful.
note: Effect kept whole: its first sentence opens with a descriptive clause. Hover and Living Metal are not defined in this book or the Core Wargear chapter. Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.

name: Dimensional Oubliette Generator
effect: The possessor of this device can, at will, generate a dimensional oubliette, an extradimensional space that can hold a single individual Necron and its wargear. The Necron inside is undetectable by any means, but can see out. It cannot affect the outside world without fully exiting the oubliette. Only the character carrying the generator can enter the Oubliette, and only a Necron can survive inside the airless, hostile environment.
note: Description runs from p.12 onto p.13. Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.

name: Grav-Platform
effect: Less a piece of wargear and more a permanent modification, a Grav Platform replaces the user’s lower half. The bearer’s Speed is increased to 10, and it may fly like a vehicle with the Hover trait. A Necron with a Grav-Platform is always considered to be braced for the purposes of firing heavy weapons.
note: Listed in the Wargear table; filed as an augmetic because it replaces the user’s lower half. Description on p.13, which prints "Grav Platform" once without the hyphen. Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.

name: Phylactery
effect: A Necron with a Phylactery heals d3 wounds rather than 1 wound from its Living Metal ability each turn.
note: Description runs from p.12 onto p.13. Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.

name: Resurrection Orb
effect: Once per session, the bearer of a Resurrection Orb may activate it as an action. When this occurs, all Necrons within 6m that are at 0 wounds or are dead may make an immediate Defiance check. If successful, they return to consciousness with d6 Wounds remaining, even if they were dead.
note: Description on p.13. "Defiance check" as printed (1st edition). Section rule (p.10): every Necron item counts as Unique to other races; only Necrons requisition it at its printed Rarity.
